scope: Verification candidate; in-process versus sidecar remains undecided.
Bounded Linux/amd64 feasibility only; no accepted production capability.

prerequisites.detail: G0 and DA-001/EC-003 design accepted. Report v3 wire, executable adapter and adoption gates remain incomplete.

licenses_notices.detail: Root license retained; study does not clear transitive per-file redistribution, fixtures, notices or release packaging.

unit_contract.detail: Bounded upstream/probe cases executed; production adapter contract and native normalization conformance remain unexecuted.

live_adapter.detail: Study probe is not the production DA-001 adapter. No live production exchange evidence.

source_integrity.detail: Synthetic study sources retained unchanged. Production acquisition, raw-response mapping and derivative authority require integration tests.

adversarial_fuzz.detail: Study includes malformed or boundary cases; no complete adopted-scope adversarial/fuzz campaign.

resources.detail: Study limits and observed consumption recorded; no reviewed production platform budget or worst-case claim.

native_platforms.detail: Linux amd64 study only. No other native target tested. Core cross-build CI is not detector platform evidence.

build_install.detail: Same-environment repeated builds match; production install, relocation and offline provisioning still need validation.

disable_rollback_missing.detail: No installed adapter: disable, rollback and missing-runtime drills cannot yet establish release behavior.

security_updates.detail: No complete transitive advisory, security response and supported-update review for adoption.

semantic_upgrade.detail: No accepted baseline or proposed upgrade. Define baseline conformance and run reviewed semantic diffs before any replacement pin.

evidence.purpose: Observed results, environment and residual limitations
Exact retained experiment artifacts, toolchain and result identities
Reproducible pinned provisioning and offline commands

limitations: Eleven final cases pass; independent fixture origin is not independent verifier execution.
Rust/CGO and system-library packaging tested only on Linux amd64.
Telemetry override and worker termination probes do not prove a production sandbox or cooperative cancellation.
next_actions: Finish #36 and a bounded worker implementation proposal.
Add independent verification, reviewed trust-profile cases and target-specific packaging evidence.
Obtain reviewed production test/platform/resource and license/security plans before adoption.
